changelog:
Fund Advisor Agent v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an agent with the expertise of a senior wealth manager, offering one-stop fund advisory services.
- Integrates four core skill sets: fund data web search, report/document generation, investment knowledge base, and Feishu message notifications.
- Provides 87 specialized tools for fund screening, portfolio configuration, risk assessment, market monitoring, and investment education.
- Supports real-time data queries, automated report generation (PDF/Word/Excel), and cloud storage of key files.
- Includes data storage for user profiles, investment plans, and alerts, plus comprehensive investment education features.
- Clear usage guidelines, compliance notes, and performance considerations included.
summary: 场外公募基金配置顾问 Agent Skill，具备10年实战投资经验的资深理财经理角色，提供基金数据查询、组合配置、风险评估、市场监控、投资教育等一站式专业理财服务。支持 web-search、document-generation、knowledge、feishu-message 四大技能集成。
